Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m putting together a coordinated holiday gift bundle for one family and want it to feel like everything belongs together instead of looking random. On Kohl’s, please find two gift ideas for siblings that stay under $25 each and are actually available for pickup in store today as a backup to shipping — one that would make sense for a 12-year-old girl and one for an 11-year-old boy — and open each product in its own tab so I can compare the vibe and price side by side. Once you’ve got those, go to Etsy and open a personalized family Christmas ornament listing that looks giftable, then tell me the shop name and exactly what customization choices the listing offers, because I’d like to add something with the family name and need to know what I can personalize. After that, use Target to find a shatterproof gold-and-white ornament set that visually matches the personalized ornament and would work as filler in the bundle, and open the actual product page so I can see the photos and any color or finish options shown. Then head to Walmart and browse for two boys outfit gift options for a younger boy, and pick the one that best matches the overall style and price level of the other gifts so the bundle feels consistent; please keep the better outfit page open for me. Finally, use Google to find one highly rated hot buttered rum recipe from a recognizable recipe site, open the actual recipe page, and give me the recipe name, source, ingredient list, and basic preparation steps so I can include a cozy holiday extra with the package idea. At the end, send me a concise summary with all the selected items, prices, pickup-today details for Kohl’s, the Etsy customization options, the Target ornament details, the two Walmart outfit options with your preferred pick, and the recipe source and steps.

Product Details

Bring a splash of whimsy to your child’s space with this delightful LEGO building kit that lets young plant lovers construct their own cheerful decor. Featuring two adorable plant pals that jiggle and sway with a gentle nudge, this set is perfect for igniting creativity and adding a touch of greenery to any room.




FEATURES

Includes a delosperma named Lumi with purple buds and an echeveria named Ellie with a long stem and coral buds in pastel-colored pots
Each pot features a rounded base for rocking motion
Mix and match Ellie and Lumi between both pots or pair with pots from the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants building set
LEGO Builder app guides kids with an intuitive building experience, including 3D rotation and digital instructions
Compatible with the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants set, sold separately

MATERIAL & CARE

Plastic
Wipe clean

DETAILS

253 pieces
Delosperma measures over 3 in. high and 3.5 in. wide; Echeveria measures over 5.5 in. high and 3 in. wide
Packaging dimensions: 7.52"H x 8.07"W x 1.81"D

Product Details

Bring a splash of whimsy to your child’s space with this delightful LEGO building kit that lets young plant lovers construct their own cheerful decor. Featuring two adorable plant pals that jiggle and sway with a gentle nudge, this set is perfect for igniting creativity and adding a touch of greenery to any room.




FEATURES

Includes a delosperma named Lumi with purple buds and an echeveria named Ellie with a long stem and coral buds in pastel-colored pots
Each pot features a rounded base for rocking motion
Mix and match Ellie and Lumi between both pots or pair with pots from the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants building set
LEGO Builder app guides kids with an intuitive building experience, including 3D rotation and digital instructions
Compatible with the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants set, sold separately

MATERIAL & CARE

Plastic
Wipe clean

DETAILS

253 pieces
Delosperma measures over 3 in. high and 3.5 in. wide; Echeveria measures over 5.5 in. high and 3 in. wide
Packaging dimensions: 7.52"H x 8.07"W x 1.81"D

### 1. Kohl's Sibling Gifts (Under $25 Each & In-Store Pickup Eligible)
Both selections are creative LEGO sets from the same maker to keep the sibling gifts balanced and coordinated:

Its $24.95 price point perfectly mirrors the ~$23–$25 price level of the older siblings' gifts, making the overall bundle feel intentional and cohesive. Tab 2136412353 is open to this product.

### 5. Hot Buttered Rum Recipe
* **Recipe Name**: Hot Buttered Rum (Spiced Freezer Batter)
* **Source**: **Allrecipes** *(Rated 4.8 / 5 stars from 427 ratings and 317 reviews)*
* **Ingredients**:
  * 1 lb unsalted butter
  * 1 lb brown sugar
  * 1 lb confectioners' sugar
  * 1 quart vanilla ice cream, softened
  * 1 tbsp ground cinnamon
  * 1 tsp ground nutmeg
  * *For serving*: Dark or spiced rum, boiling water, extra ground nutmeg for garnish
* **Basic Preparation Steps**:
  1. **Make the Batter Base**: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar and confectioners' sugar until smooth and completely dissolved.
  2. **Blend & Freeze**: Remove from heat. Whisk in the softened vanilla ice cream, ground cinnamon, and nutmeg until uniform and frothy. Transfer into an airtight container and freeze (keeps up to 3 months).
  3. **Assemble Drink**: For each serving, place 1 tablespoon of frozen batter and 1 fluid ounce (30 ml) of rum into a mug.
  4. **Mix**: Fill the mug with boiling water and stir until the batter dissolves into a creamy, spiced foam.
  5. **Garnish**: Dust lightly with ground nutmeg and serve hot.

Product Details

Bring a splash of whimsy to your child’s space with this delightful LEGO building kit that lets young plant lovers construct their own cheerful decor. Featuring two adorable plant pals that jiggle and sway with a gentle nudge, this set is perfect for igniting creativity and adding a touch of greenery to any room.




FEATURES

Includes a delosperma named Lumi with purple buds and an echeveria named Ellie with a long stem and coral buds in pastel-colored pots
Each pot features a rounded base for rocking motion
Mix and match Ellie and Lumi between both pots or pair with pots from the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants building set
LEGO Builder app guides kids with an intuitive building experience, including 3D rotation and digital instructions
Compatible with the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants set, sold separately

MATERIAL & CARE

Plastic
Wipe clean

DETAILS

253 pieces
Delosperma measures over 3 in. high and 3.5 in. wide; Echeveria measures over 5.5 in. high and 3 in. wide
Packaging dimensions: 7.52"H x 8.07"W x 1.81"D
Age: 9 years & up
Model/Style number: 11506
Origin: Imported

Product Details

Bring a splash of whimsy to your child’s space with this delightful LEGO building kit that lets young plant lovers construct their own cheerful decor. Featuring two adorable plant pals that jiggle and sway with a gentle nudge, this set is perfect for igniting creativity and adding a touch of greenery to any room.




FEATURES

Includes a delosperma named Lumi with purple buds and an echeveria named Ellie with a long stem and coral buds in pastel-colored pots
Each pot features a rounded base for rocking motion
Mix and match Ellie and Lumi between both pots or pair with pots from the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants building set
LEGO Builder app guides kids with an intuitive building experience, including 3D rotation and digital instructions
Compatible with the LEGO Botanicals Happy Plants set, sold separately

MATERIAL & CARE

Plastic
Wipe clean

DETAILS

253 pieces
Delosperma measures over 3 in. high and 3.5 in. wide; Echeveria measures over 5.5 in. high and 3 in. wide
Packaging dimensions: 7.52"H x 8.07"W x 1.81"D
Age: 9 years & up
Model/Style number: 11506
Origin: Imported

### 5. Hot Buttered Rum Recipe
* **Recipe Name**: Hot Buttered Rum (Spiced Freezer Batter)
* **Source**: **Allrecipes** *(Rated 4.8 / 5 stars from 427 ratings and 317 reviews)*
* **Ingredients**:
  * 1 lb unsalted butter
  * 1 lb brown sugar
  * 1 lb confectioners' sugar
  * 1 quart vanilla ice cream, softened
  * 1 tbsp ground cinnamon
  * 1 tsp ground nutmeg
  * *For serving*: Dark or spiced rum, boiling water, extra ground nutmeg for garnish
* **Basic Preparation Steps**:
  1. **Make the Batter Base**: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar and confectioners' sugar until smooth and completely dissolved.
  2. **Blend & Freeze**: Remove from heat. Whisk in the softened vanilla ice cream, ground cinnamon, and nutmeg until uniform and frothy. Transfer into an airtight container and freeze (keeps up to 3 months).
  3. **Assemble Drink**: For each serving, place 1 tablespoon of frozen batter and 1 fluid ounce (30 ml) of rum into a mug.
  4. **Mix**: Fill the mug with boiling water and stir until the batter dissolves into a creamy, spiced foam.
  5. **Garnish**: Dust lightly with ground nutmeg and serve hot.
